subject: Mistake: The new version was not installed.

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Mistake: The new version was not installed.
parts:
Hi,

the new version (v0.9.1) of the package was uploaded a few days ago,
but I forgot to updates some other files so that if you tried to
update it would still only find the old version. Please retry now:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix")

Cheers

Henrik

messages.author: e3daea24651c4835
messages.subject: Re: Mistake: The new version was not installed.
parts:
Hi Henrik,

It seems that some errors remain, since the installer tries to
download .tgz packages instead of .tar.gz ones:

Updating packages: R.methodsS3, R.oo, R.utils from http://www.braju.com/R/repos
01/03. R.methodsS3: v1.0.1, i.e. up to date.
02/03. R.oo: v1.4.2, but v1.4.3 is available, i.e. out of date.
Updating:
trying URL 'http://www.braju.com/R/repos/R.oo_1.4.3.tgz'
Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb") :
cannot open URL 'http://www.braju.com/R/repos/R.oo_1.4.3.tgz'
In addition: Warning message:
In download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb") :
cannot open: HTTP status was '404 Not Found'
Warning in download.packages(p0, destdir = tmpd, available =
available, :
download of package 'R.oo' failed
03/03. R.utils: v1.0.1, but v1.0.2 is available, i.e. out of date.
Updating:
trying URL 'http://www.braju.com/R/repos/R.utils_1.0.2.tgz'
Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb") :
cannot open URL 'http://www.braju.com/R/repos/R.utils_1.0.2.tgz'
In addition: Warning message:
In download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb") :
cannot open: HTTP status was '404 Not Found'
Warning in download.packages(p0, destdir = tmpd, available =
available, :
download of package 'R.utils' failed

Best,
Nicolas

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: Mistake: The new version was not installed.
parts:
Hi,

there was a bug in the online hbLite() function that caused it to try
to install Mac binary versions of exactly those packages - now they
are also installed from source. It should work now.

/Henrik
